name: ESP-Environment-Drivers
description: Thread-safe I2C drivers for the SHT31, BMP388/BMP390 and MPU6050 on the ESP32. Transactions are serialised per bus with FreeRTOS mutexes, so sensors sharing a bus can be read from different tasks. No Adafruit dependencies.
keywords: sensor, i2c, sht31, sht3x, bmp388, bmp390, bmp3xx, mpu6050, barometer, humidity, freertos, thread-safe, weather
